digest.component_or_area: Git hooks installation and pre-commit integration
propositions: The documented curl command using `git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg` resolves to the shared common hooks directory from linked worktrees, causing it to silently overwrite the pre-commit wrapper and break Change-Id stamping for all worktrees.

Running the documented install destroys the pre-commit migration chain that runs both the 50/72 message gate and the Gerrit Change-Id stamper, resulting in silent failure at commit time that only surfaces during `git push gerrit` in a different worktree.

The unsafe curl path is documented in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md as the recommended installation method, but fails to preserve the non-destructive pre-commit hook chaining arrangement that `.pre-commit-config.yaml` explicitly prescribes.

A single idempotent documented installation path (`make hooks` calling `scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh`) must replace the bare curl to ensure worktree-safe, non-destructive, and verifiable Change-Id stamping across all worktrees.

The installer must refuse to overwrite a pre-commit wrapper with an explicit error, install to `commit-msg.legacy` when a wrapper is present, validate the downloaded payload contains Change-Id logic, and work identically from the main checkout or any linked worktree.
